rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Variable weights: use font-light for elegance and font-bold for impact.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm to shadow-md) on product cards. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200) on all product and category cards.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds for most elements. Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80) ONLY for sticky headers.

components.category_row: Horizontal scroll container (overflow-x-auto, no scrollbar) on mobile. Items: Circular image wrapper (w-16 h-16 rounded-full border border-slate-200) with small text underneath.
components.product_card: Minimalist card (no Shadcn Card if it feels rigid), clean image, bold price, add to cart button.
components.checkout_manual_payment: Clean upload zone (dashed border, bg-slate-50). Required fields: Admin managed Account Number, IFSC code, Amount. User must upload screenshot.
components.coupon_section: Show list of available coupons as clickable tags/pills near the input field. On click -> injects value into input & applies.

grids.desktop: Standard e-commerce grid (grid-cols-4 or 5) for products, grid-cols-8/12 for bento marketing sections.
grids.mobile: grid-cols-2 for products, horizontal flex for categories.

layouts.header: Sticky nav with Logo (DM Mobile), Search, Cart, User.
layouts.footer: Must display: 'Powered by DMobileMart-Muskan'. Include comprehensive list of policy links (Privacy, Terms, Returns).
layouts.admin_order_review: Show user-uploaded payment screenshot. Add 'Approve & Capture' and 'Reject' buttons. Fix 'Confirm' logic.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg on product cards.
motion.interactions: Button active scale down (scale-95). Smooth expansion of coupon sections.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio on background. Ensure primary blue has good contrast with white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid='category-item'`, `data-testid='payment-upload-button'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebrand: Replace all occurrences of old shop names with 'DM Mobile' / 'DMobileMart'.
Footer: Append 'Powered by DMobileMart-Muskan' and render Policy links (Refund, Privacy, Terms).
Category UI Fix: Debug why categories aren't opening. Redesign them to match Flipkart (horizontal mobile scroll, circular images).
Product Admin: Add 'IMEI Number' and 'Barcode' fields in product creation/edit.
Customer Bill: Ensure the IMEI/Barcode reflects on the customer's invoice/bill after a successful order.

Payment Flow - E-Commerce: For UPI/Direct Transfer, fetch Admin-set Account Number and IFSC. Display manual payment instructions. Provide file upload for the screenshot. Do not proceed order without this screenshot if manual payment is selected.

Payment Flow - Admin: In Order details, add Payment Control Panel. Show uploaded screenshot. Add 'Confirm/Capture' and 'Reject' buttons. On capture, update order status and wallet (if applicable). Ensure 'Confirm Order' button actually updates DB.
Coupons: In checkout, fetch and render available coupons as a visible list/pills near the coupon code input. Clicking a coupon pill should auto-fill the input and trigger the apply function.
Testing: Add `data-testid` to all new elements (e.g., `data-testid='imei-input'`, `data-testid='coupon-pill'`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, crystal_ball, dart etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts.
Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain visual hierarchy: larger fonts and high contrast for primary actions.
Design mobile-first. Test tap targets to be at least 44x44pt.
Provide clear feedback for user actions (loading spinners, success toasts for coupon application).
Keep forms minimal; inline validation for the screenshot upload (size/type).
